weather.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo and NOAA GFS; CC BY 4.0
weather.past: Archived day-0 model output; three/seven-day windows ending D-2, not station observations
weather.future: Forecasts at fixed five-day lead for D+1..D+3; mixed earlier runs, not realised future weather
weather.availability: Every included hourly value has valid_time - lead_time + 6h < D 00:00 UTC
weather.spatial_method: Nearest configured weather sampling point; no claim of local station resolution

context.land_cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, released 2022; static historical context
context.land_attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium; CC BY 4.0
context.land_sampling: Class fractions from 32x COG overview (0.002667 degrees, about 300 m); approximate, not native 10 m area fractions
context.terrain: Copernicus GLO-90 public DSM; mean elevation, elevation variation and slope at ~90 m
context.terrain_attribution: © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018; provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA
context.limitations: Static land cover cannot establish ignition cause, distinguish controlled burns, identify crop species, or measure current fuel moisture. DSM slope includes vegetation/infrastructure and tile-edge approximation.

candidate_population: All Thailand grid-cell centres, including cells without any previous hotspot

selection.method: Three expanding chronological validation blocks within the fitting period; 3-day label purge
selection.rule: Maximize mean average precision among candidates with mean Brier <= weather baseline + 0.002 and mean recall at 2% FPR >= weather baseline; tie favors fewer features
selection.note: ROC budget points are descriptive validation metrics, not deployed thresholds; the display/model threshold is unchanged
